detail: The target threshold (95th percentile of paid_amount) was computed on all_data including the test set, violating train-test separation. The test set should be held out before target definition; including it here inflates performance metrics.

remediation: feature_set: features parameter: remove 'billed_amount' and 'allowed_amount' from the list
detail: The feature set includes billed_amount and allowed_amount, which are directly correlated with the target (paid_amount). This represents information leakage; the model learns to predict cost from related cost fields rather than from clinical/operational characteristics available at claim intake, defeating the purpose of an early-warning model.
